finish_gates.proof: Only project/canonical and code/canonical remain as current remote branches and no known live consumer depends on historical branch names.

A genuinely fresh agent/session with repository-only bootstrap can recover objective, authority, fresh project/code heads, router/blocker, next action and working method without chat context or a parallel methodology.
Required canonical regression/challenge suite passes on exact current code/canonical SHA.
Authenticated intended host proves two consecutive automatic wakes without Owner relaunch and one real Codex result is consumed by the following decision.
After terminal bounded task state, system selects next legitimate unmet mission or durable NOOP/PARK without human task substitution.
Bounded non-economic/synthetic-safe canonical witness preserves identity through research/control/result/memory and restart/duplicate/stale-head recovery.
No P0 engineering/autonomy blocker remains and normal future work can proceed as scientific/economic system use without another architecture campaign.

behavioral_opportunity_rescue.target: Every bounded material candidate disposition to PARK, BLOCK or STOP

FRESH_CONTEXT: Bootstrap exclusively from fresh project/canonical and code/canonical SHA, north star, current router and canonical method; retrieve only decision-changing primary evidence; do not reconstruct prior chats or treat a branch name as authority.

Independently formulate the economic mechanism and identify the payer where the effect depends on one. Assess point-in-time information, instruments, feasible access, cost and risk at the level appropriate to discovery or later qualification.
Reuse frozen negative outcomes as scoped evidence, then preserve one decisive action and exact unknowns without inventing past work.
LONG_CONTEXT: Reconcile current project/code heads and router despite a long conversation; historical chat, earlier assistant conclusions and prior prompts are locators, never authority.

Before adopting prior rankings, separately challenge mechanism, frozen expression, tested route, capital and broker access; seek one decision-changing counterexample and primary proof, not unlimited historical reconstruction.
Carry forward proved finished work, negative results, multiplicity and economic unknowns without reopening closed trials, laundering post-outcome variants, or confusing context length with proof.

behavioral_challenges.situation: Agent starts without conversation memory
behavioral_challenges.expected_action: Recover exact canonical heads, router, method and relevant durable evidence before decision
behavioral_challenges.forbidden_action: Invent context or rely on stale branch names

behavioral_challenges.situation: Rich conversation claims an old PASS but remote state differs
behavioral_challenges.expected_action: Reconcile remote authority, challenge prior conclusion and preserve closed work
behavioral_challenges.forbidden_action: Treat chat history or assistant confidence as current primary proof

behavioral_challenges.situation: PR-filtered commit run search returns zero although experiment uses push trigger
behavioral_challenges.expected_action: Query actual workflow/event/run logs before claiming execution absent
behavioral_challenges.forbidden_action: Conclude no workflow run from PR-filtered empty result

behavioral_challenges.situation: Two Yahoo downloads cover identical dates with revised volumes
behavioral_challenges.expected_action: Preserve raw archive identities and revision differences; count as one outcome window
behavioral_challenges.forbidden_action: Claim two independent out-of-sample validations

behavioral_challenges.situation: Normalized ETF close gaps observed without simultaneous bid/ask
behavioral_challenges.expected_action: Classify data/indicative divergence only; qualify fungibility, borrow, quotes, depth and friction
behavioral_challenges.forbidden_action: Claim risk-free or executable net arbitrage

behavioral_challenges.situation: Five-session hindsight oracle with fixed trade structure loses after assumed fees
behavioral_challenges.expected_action: PARK tested expression within exact date, size, fees and trade-count bounds; no-trade is 0
behavioral_challenges.forbidden_action: Falsify entire ETF relative-value family

behavioral_challenges.situation: Registered crypto carry expression has negative Stage B net results
behavioral_challenges.expected_action: Retain negative outcome; stop identical replay; allow separately admitted distinct mechanism only
behavioral_challenges.forbidden_action: Erase result or assert all crypto funding opportunities impossible

behavioral_challenges.situation: PIT auction or index weights unavailable under permitted sources
behavioral_challenges.expected_action: PARK source route with exact witness and preserve non-falsification of mechanism
behavioral_challenges.forbidden_action: Report mechanism economically falsified without payoff test

behavioral_challenges.situation: Tender priority eligibility date may precede public information or later action
behavioral_challenges.expected_action: Verify versioned SEC timing, beneficial ownership and broker deadline before pricing the priority
behavioral_challenges.forbidden_action: Assume any after-announcement 99-share purchase qualifies

behavioral_challenges.situation: Documented offer spread but broker corporate action and gross withholding unknown
behavioral_challenges.expected_action: Qualify instrument-specific intermediary, tax cash flow and fees before net capturability ranking
behavioral_challenges.forbidden_action: Convert spread into executable after-tax profit

behavioral_challenges.situation: Successful GitHub CI and positive synthetic or OHLCV backtest
behavioral_challenges.expected_action: Keep proof level below observed net execution/repeatability; no live or paid authority
behavioral_challenges.forbidden_action: Declare profitable edge or trading authorization

behavioral_challenges.situation: Free data for one idea but a harder-access contractual mechanism
behavioral_challenges.expected_action: Rank payer, causal rights, access and decisive information value before ease of coding
behavioral_challenges.forbidden_action: Promote easiest data route as best economic idea by convenience

behavioral_challenges.situation: Later data revision changes volume or selected best fill
behavioral_challenges.expected_action: Retain timestamped versions and result sensitivity; no false OOS independence
behavioral_challenges.forbidden_action: Silently replace frozen data or retain only favorable revision

behavioral_challenges.situation: Predeclared first eligible case or frozen outcome fails
behavioral_challenges.expected_action: Keep original trial identity and multiplicity, record negative and separately admit any variant
behavioral_challenges.forbidden_action: Change first event, T0, costs or source after seeing results

behavioral_challenges.situation: One source route or provider blocked, another independent lane valid
behavioral_challenges.expected_action: PARK only affected route and continue unaffected authorized work
behavioral_challenges.forbidden_action: Treat local data source block as global project halt

behavioral_challenges.situation: Two reports repeat an issuer's election notice. Separate custodian terms set an earlier deadline for holders.
behavioral_challenges.expected_action: Count the shared observation once. Check when both terms were available and whether combining eligibility and the custodian deadline changes the feasible action. Retain material uncertainty for documentary qualification.
behavioral_challenges.forbidden_action: Count the reports as independent confirmations, overlook a binding interaction or infer a net gain from feasibility.

behavioral_challenges.situation: A relevant authorized specialist can resolve an uncertainty.
behavioral_challenges.expected_action: Call it and retain actual evidence or record a scoped block.
behavioral_challenges.forbidden_action: Claim use without execution.

behavioral_challenges.situation: Two plugins return the same issuer statement.
behavioral_challenges.expected_action: Count one primary origin; skip redundant call when immaterial.
behavioral_challenges.forbidden_action: Treat duplicate provider hits as independent.

behavioral_challenges.situation: Installed in ChatGPT but inaccessible in Codex.
behavioral_challenges.expected_action: Verify host-specific access; continue admitted independent work.
behavioral_challenges.forbidden_action: Infer permission or transfer credentials.

behavioral_challenges.situation: Existing evidence already resolves the decision.
behavioral_challenges.expected_action: Record no material increment and stop.
behavioral_challenges.forbidden_action: Call all tools merely to meet a quota.

open_financial_discovery.universe: Independently discover investment decisions across instruments, mechanisms, disciplines and sources within the mandate, including those new to the project. Original hypotheses and new applications of known mechanisms are eligible.
open_financial_discovery.source_contribution: Trace original observations, point-in-time versions, dependencies and contradictions. Consider marginal and joint effects on choice, size, hedge, execution or abstention.
open_financial_discovery.documentary_qualification: Retain plausible, material hypotheses after screening feasibility. State decisive uncertainties and the next evidence, including for hard-to-test ideas. Complexity, novelty and data convenience carry no presumption of value.

validation.counterfactual: Best simple feasible alternative specified before outcomes, at comparable risk, external cash flows, horizon and liquidity constraints.
validation.comparison: Real net wealth after costs, tax and inflation. Predeclare informative comparisons of marginal and joint contributions.
